Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style Mister Ginger Tristan Portraits
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portrait of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5295]Mister Ginger (cat NPC)[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6675]Tristan[/url] mod Characters Mr Ginger and Tristan, Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait.
If you only want Mr Ginger you can just download the portrait for Mr Ginger only.

Tristan's portrait includes all 3 color variations, includes seasonal outfit portraits.

Make sure you have PyTK mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)*
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]
Find where you installed your Mr Ginger and Tristan mod (somewhere in Stardew Valley\Mods folder)
Drag the folders from my zip [b]([CP] MrGinger, [CP] Tristan )[/b] to the[b] Stardew Valley\Mods\[NPC] MisterGinger, [/b][b]Stardew Valley\Mods\[NPC] Tristan[/b] folder to overwrite the folders in it for it to work. 



Uploaded content Patcher version.
I would still recommend the replacement file version since the assets won't get loaded 2 times. But if the replacement file doesn't work for you, try this version.



Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. (And ofc [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5295]Mister Ginger (cat NPC)[/url], or if you want Tristan too, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6675]Tristan[/url]﻿ mod.)

The characters belong to the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5295]Mister Ginger (cat NPC)[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6675]Tristan[/url]﻿: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657]lemurkat[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
